item.title: PCB considers legal action against players opting out of PSL for IPL
item.description: Pakistan Cricket Board has taken a firm stance against overseas players withdrawing from PSL 2026. For the PCB, it’s about protecting the league’s integrity and enforcing contracts.

item.title: MS Dhoni’s witty reply to Sivakarthikeyan’s ‘Play till 60’ question wins hearts
item.description: MS Dhoni gave a hilarious response to 'Play till 60' query at the Roar '26. The Roar '26 event also saw Dhoni honouring the next generation of CSK stars.

item.title: WI-W vs AUS-W, 3rd T20I Match Prediction: Who will win today’s game between West Indies and Australia?
item.description: West Indies will take on Australia in the 3rd T20I at Arnos Vale Ground, Kingstown. Australia have set sight on completing clean sweep in the final T20I.

item.title: SWOT analysis of Delhi Capitals: DC’s report card ahead of IPL 2026
item.description: Delhi Capitals head into IPL 2026 aiming to end their title drought with a balanced squad under Axar Patel. A strong spin core and explosive batting boost DC's hopes, but pace depth and fielding remain concerns ahead of the season opener.

item.title: “My wife played a huge role in calming me down”: Varun Chakravarthy on panic attacks and his rise with KKR
item.description: KKR spinner Varun Chakravarthy reflected on panic attacks and his rise in the IPL. KKR will kick off their IPL 2026 campaign with clash against Mumbai Indians on March 29.

item.title: Meet Saurabh Dubey: The Vidarbha left-armer who steps in as Akash Deep’s replacement for KKR in IPL 2026
item.description: Saurabh Dubey’s move from domestic circuits to the IPL spotlight is a story of quiet persistence and timely opportunity. After limited exposure in first-class and List A cricket, the 28-year-old pacer now gets his big break with the Kolkata Knight Riders.

item.title: Kashvee Gautam earns maiden call-up as India announce Women’s T20I squad for South Africa tour
item.description: BCCI has announced India women's T20I squad for the upcoming tour of South Africa. Kashvee Gautam has earned her maiden call-up in the shortest format.

item.title: From Carlos Brathwaite to Wasim Akram: Star-studded commentary panel announced for PSL 2026
item.description: PCB has officially revealed a power-packed commentary panel for the 11th edition of the Pakistan Super League. PSL 2026 is set to be played from March 26 to May 3.

item.title: SWOT analysis of Chennai Super Kings: CSK’s report card ahead of IPL 2026
item.description: Chennai Super Kings begin IPL 2026 with a youth-focused rebuild after a poor 2025, led by Ruturaj Gaikwad and Sanju Samson. Strong batting and spin boost hopes, but weak death bowling and inexperience remain key concerns.

item.title: IPL 2026: Matthew Hayden picks Gujarat Titans star worthy of his iconic mongoose bat
item.description: Matthew Hayden picked his mongoose bat successor in Gujarat Titans camp. The Mongoose bat became iconic in IPL thanks to how effectively Hayden used it for CSK.

item.title: IPL 2026: Kavya Maran’s SRH sign veteran England pacer as replacement for Australian all-rounder Jack Edwards
item.description: Sunrisers Hyderabad have announced Jack Edwards' replacement for IPL 2026. SRH will take on RCB in the opening match of the season.

item.title: Aakash Chopra predicts CSK’s probable XI for IPL 2026
item.description: Aakash Chopra has shared his predicted playing XI of CSK for the upcoming IPL 2026. CSK's squad decisions ahead of IPL 2026 have sparked optimism among fans and experts alike.

item.title: Will Yash Dayal play IPL 2026? RCB Director of Cricket provides big update
item.description: RCB Director of Cricket has dropped big update on Yash Dayal's availability for IPL 2026. RCB will begin their title defence with the clash against SRH on March 28.

item.title: IPL 2026: DC skipper Axar Patel explains why he is not a fan of ‘Impact Player Rule’
item.description: Axar Patel has revealed why he does not like the Impact Player rule in IPL. Axar is all set to lead Delhi Capitals in the upcoming season of the cash-rich league.

item.title: Will Jasprit Bumrah miss IPL 2026? MI star’s CoE visit raises questions
item.description: Jasprit Bumrah's recent visit to the BCCI's CoE has raised questions about his participation in IPL 2026. The concern isn’t just about Bumrah missing a game -it's about losing the backbone of MI's bowling attack.
